8.3.5 J1939Dcm_GenericDMxTransmit
[SWS_J1939Dcm_91007]
Definition of API function J1939Dcm_GenericDMx
Transmit
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04241
⌈
Service Name
J1939Dcm_GenericDMxTransmit
Syntax
Std_ReturnType J1939Dcm_GenericDMxTransmit (
uint8 dmId,
uint8 node,
NetworkHandleType channel,
uint8 destAddress,
uint8 priority
)
Service ID [hex]
0x49
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
dmId
Number of the J1939 diagnostic message.
node
Node by which the message shall be sent.
channel
Channel on which the message shall be transmitted
destAddress
Address of the node that shall receive the diagnostic message or
0xFF for broadcast.
Parameters (in)
priority
Priority of the diagnostic message.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Transmit request has been accepted.
E_NOT_OK: Transmit request has not been accepted.
▽
Manager for SAE J1939
△
Description
Requests transmission of a diagnostic message
Available via
J1939Dcm.h
⌋
[SWS_J1939Dcm_00206]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04241, SRS_BSW_00386
⌈If the configuration parameter J1939DcmDevErrorDetect is enabled, the func-
tion J1939Dcm_GenericDMxTransmit shall check if the dmId parameter addresses
a configured (via J1939DcmDiagnosticMessageSupport) but unsupported DMx
message. In case of an error, the function J1939Dcm_GenericDMxTransmit shall
return without any effect and shall report the error to the Default Error Tracer
with the error code J1939DCM_E_INVALID_PGN.⌋
